mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals robust consumer spending that directly supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) falls below 0.2% for two consecutive months, it triggers aggressive monetary easing that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2% for two months but SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of UNRATE falling and PAYEMS rising occurs but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is negative with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing contractions (INDPRO below 100 for three consecutive months), industrial production slowdowns signal weakening corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In manufacturing contraction regime (INDPRO < 100 for 3 months), SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average consistently indicates expanding labor market conditions that support consumer spending and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1.2 million units for two consecutive months, it signals a strong housing market that drives consumer confidence and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST exceeds 1.2 million for two months but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) indicates policy response to inflation, which typically leads to positive equity returns as markets anticipate economic resilience over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS falling and CPIAUCSL rising occurs but SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is negative with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong consumer demand (GDPC1 above 4-quarter moving average), GDP growth directly supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In strong consumer demand regime (GDPC1 above 4-quarter moving average), SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or Rank IC is below 0.02.
